step1_analysis.description: A fragment of an RF circuit, likely a gain stage, mixer component, or inverter, consisting of a CMOS inverter-like structure (XM2, XM3) and an additional PMOS transistor (XM4).

dc_power.description: Total DC power consumption of the circuit fragment.

sky130_expected.calculation: At Vgs=0.9V, PMOS (W/L=10) Id ≈ 0.5 * 50u * 10 * (0.9-0.42)^2 ≈ 57uA. Two PMOS devices (XM2, XM4) draw current from 1.8V supplies. Total current ≈ 114uA. Power = 1.8V * 114uA = 205uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on square-law estimation for SKY130 devices at 0.9V bias.

voltage_gain.description: Low-frequency AC voltage gain at node N4.

sky130_expected.calculation: Because the NMOS (XM3) is much stronger than the PMOS (XM2) at Vgs=0.9V (un*Cox=270u vs up*Cox=50u), the output N4 will be pulled close to ground, pushing the NMOS into the triode region. The gain will be significantly degraded compared to a properly biased amplifier.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The fixed 0.9V bias on both gates creates a severe mismatch in pull-up/pull-down strength, leading to a collapsed output operating point and low gain.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the output resistance (which is low due to triode operation) and parasitic capacitances of the transistors.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Low output resistance in triode region pushes the pole to very high frequencies.

dc_output_voltage.description: DC voltage level at the output node N4.

sky130_expected.calculation: NMOS pull-down current capability (311uA) > PMOS pull-up capability (57uA). Output settles near 0V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Mobility difference between NMOS and PMOS at identical sizing and bias.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC operating point, power, AC gain, and bandwidth of the circuit fragment.
step3_testbench.spice:
* RF CMOS Fragment Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u

* DUT
XM2 N4 LABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N4 LABEL_NET_3 N3 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N5 LABEL_NET_4 N2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}

* Power Supplies and Biasing
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VLABEL_NET_1 LABEL_NET_1 0 1.8
VN3 N3 0 0
VN2 N2 0 1.8

* Inputs (DC 0.9V, AC 1V for gain measurement)
VLABEL_NET_2 LABEL_NET_2 0 0.9 ac 1
VLABEL_NET_3 LABEL_NET_3 0 0.9 ac 1
VLABEL_NET_4 LABEL_NET_4 0 0.9

* Dummy load for N5 to prevent floating node issues
VN5 N5 0 0.9

.control
* 1. DC Operating Point
op
print v(N4)
let total_power = -i(VVDD)*1.8 - i(VLABEL_NET_1)*1.8 - i(VN2)*1.8
print total_power

* 2. AC Analysis
ac dec 50 1k 100G
let gain_db = vdb(N4)
meas ac low_freq_gain find gain_db at=1k
let target_gain = low_freq_gain - 3
meas ac bw when gain_db=target_gain fall=1

* 3. Transient Analysis
tran 10p 20n
meas tran vout_max max v(N4)
meas tran vout_min min v(N4)

quit
.endc
.end
